name: rosetta-multiton
code:
use default

class MULTITON[K, V] is
    _create: K -> V
    _instances: MAP[K, V]
    _lock: object

    init(create: K -> V) is
        _create = create
        _instances = MAP()
        _lock = object()
    si

    get(key: K) -> V is
        let use _ = LOCK(_lock)

        let existing: V mut

        if _instances.try_get_value(key, existing ref) then
            return existing
        fi

        let created = _create(key)

        _instances[key] = created

        return created
    si

    count: int => _instances.count
si

class CONNECTION(host: string) is
    to_string() -> string => "connection to {host}"
si

class LOCK: Ghul.Disposable is
    _lock: object

    init(lock: object) is
        _lock = lock

        System.Threading.Monitor.enter(_lock)
    si

    dispose() is
        System.Threading.Monitor.exit(_lock)
    si
si

let made mut = 0

let connections =
    MULTITON(
        host => (
            made = made + 1

            CONNECTION(host)
        )
    )

let alpha = connections.get("alpha")
let beta = connections.get("beta")
let alpha_again = connections.get("alpha")

write_line("{alpha}")
write_line("{beta}")

write_line(
    "asking twice for alpha gives the same object: {alpha == alpha_again}")
write_line("alpha and beta are different objects: {alpha != beta}")
write_line(
    "requests: 3, instances made: {made}, "
    "instances held: {connections.count}")

let keys = ["one", "two", "three"]

Tasks.Parallel.`for(
    0,
    300,
    i => (
        let _ = connections.get(keys[i % keys.count])
    )
)

write_line(
    "300 more requests over {keys.count} keys, in parallel: "
    "{made} made in total, {connections.count} held")
